ground_metric.position_arc: min(abs(x-x') mod L, L - (abs(x-x') mod L))

measure_contract.support_canonicalization: periodic position reduction, deterministic sort, co-located weight aggregation
measure_contract.mass_match: relative total mass mismatch must be at most 1e-12
measure_contract.normalization: balanced measures are normalized to probability mass after strict original-mass match
measure_contract.mass_mismatch_output: original candidate/reference total masses and relative mismatch are retained
measure_contract.empty_measure: two empty measures have zero cost; one empty and one nonempty is rejected

solver.shortest_path: Bellman-Ford on residual graph with negative reverse arcs
solver.not_claimed: production Sinkhorn, GPU OT, NUFFT OT or large-scale solver

claim_limits: Balanced W1 is defined only for nonnegative equal-mass measures under the admitted tolerance.
The ground metric and scales are part of the benchmark identity.
Signed delta-f measures are not supported by this API.
The small-N reference is not a production-scale transport algorithm or a physical solver certificate.
Transport is a separate fidelity observable from characteristic MMD and physical residuals.
